posts.text: still building your mvp for over 6 months? 🐢 here's what you should do👇 - remove the extra features being added - ignore UI Perfection - use tools like Cursor, Windsurf, Claude to fasten your building - set goals everyday to ship/fix bugs and code for 4 hours a day - focus on distribution, how u can market your product and finally speed>>>>>perfection. the faster you release the more feedback you get. #startup #tech #advice #mvp #innovation, #management, #humanresources, and #digitalmarketing #m
Your first 100 users don’t want perfection—they want: - A fix for their problem - Dead-simple usability - Speedy results Founders, listen up: Ship it. Iterate later. Done beats perfect every time.
